Summary

I design complex AI, enterprise, and B2B SaaS products, including AI/ML platforms, API workflows, and developer tools. I combine systems thinking, research, and AI-assisted prototyping to lead complex product initiatives, shape design practices across teams, and turn ambiguous problems into intuitive experiences. I also contribute to hiring and team growth, mentor designers, and partner closely with product and engineering teams to build cohesive products.
